text:
Situation: Micafungin is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Par Health, USA LLC posted a discontinuation notice on 2026-09-11, which appears on FDA's shortage list as To Be Discontinued. Current stock provides 13.3 to 31 days of supply across Corvale East and Corvale General.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1236639 at Zydus Lifesciences Limited (FEI 3013712903), the registered plant for NDC 70771168301, ended 2024-04-23 and was classified OAI with 10 observations including absence of written procedures and validation lacking for sterile drug products. A Warning Letter was issued to that plant on 2024-08-29. Recall D-0596-2024 for micafungin for injection 100 mg/vial manufactured for Northstar Rx LLC was initiated 2024-07-02 and classified Class III for cross contamination with other products.

Our position: Supply is adequate for the near term. The Par Health discontinuation reduces one source but other manufacturers remain available and are not on FDA's shortage list. No clinical changes are recommended at this time.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to qualify and purchase from Baxter Healthcare Corporation as primary alternate source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to qualify Biocon Pharma Inc., Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc. USA, and Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. as secondary sources; each requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report any new listings to P&T committee chair.
4. Inventory team to track daily usage and update days-on-hand for both campuses; report to buyer every Monday.

Not recommended: Do not initiate conservation protocols, dose rounding, or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
